name: [forge-admin] push run_not_alive — a live campaign lost its worker
message:
The recovery sweep found a campaign still scheduled or sending whose durable run the runtime no longer holds, and retired its pending groups. The rest of that wave never sent.

This is the worker-outage signal: the sweep runs at worker start, so this line means a previous worker went away mid-wave. Read the campaign page for the stale-worker state and the report for the missed count.

Known limitation, stated on purpose: this fires when the NEXT worker boots, not while the worker is away. The plan's "heartbeat stale while a campaign is scheduled or sending" needs a periodic emitter that does not exist yet, because the worker heartbeat writes database rows and logs nothing. Until one exists, watch the workflows dashboard workers section for a heartbeat under 45 seconds during any wave. See infra/datadog-monitors/push/README.md.
